com.vector.cfg.automation.api.project

Interface IProjectHandlingRawApi


  • @PublishedApi(value=ADDITIONS_ALLOWED)
 @PublishedApiDomain(value=AUTOMATION_IF)
public interface IProjectHandlingRawApi
    The Interface IProjectHandlingRawApi provides methods to handle raw AUTOSAR models.
    Sometimes it could be helpful to create an empty AUTOSAR model or load single ARXML file. This is called raw mode (IProjectHandlingRawApi).

    You could for example create an empty AUTOSAR model add elements and then export the snippet as an ARXML file.

    In raw mode most of the provided services and APIs will disabled, like:

    • Ecuc access
    • BswmdModel support
    • Generation
    • Validation
    • Workflow
    • Domain API
    • ChangeInspector
    • and more

      • emptyAutosarModel

        @PublishedMethod
<T> T emptyAutosarModel(java.lang.String autosarVersion,
                                          AsrPath rootPackage,
                                          @DelegatesTo(strategy=1,value=IProject.class) @VClassClosureParams(value={IProject.class,com.vector.cfg.model.mdf.model.autosar.base.MIARPackage.class})
                                          groovy.lang.Closure<T> code)
        The #emptyAutosarModel(String, Closure) method creates a new empty AUTOSAR model, only containing one MIARPackage created by this method with the path AsrPath. The passed AUTOSAR version defines the version of the AUTOSAR model, the version is specified in the format "4.2.1" or "4.0.3", ...
        Parameters:
        version - the AUTOSAR version to create like "4.2.1", see IVersion for details.
        rootPackage - the rootPackage to create in the empty model
        code - the code (a Closure) to be executed on the opened IProject and the create MIARPackage
